# Advisories the console-web job (.github/workflows/quality.yml) accepts in
# console/web/package-lock.json, read by .github/scripts/check_npm_audit.py:
# one per line, the advisory id first, then the date it is accepted until
# (YYYY-MM-DD: past it the advisory gates again), the package and its version,
# and why it does not apply. Accept only an advisory with no fixed release
# that does not reach the built client; remove the line when a fixed release
# is locked, and re-read the reason on every bump of the package.
